name: When should I consider adding a bathroom to my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider adding a bathroom to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider adding a bathroom if your current home-to-bathroom ratio is causing inconvenience, you frequently host guests, or you are looking to increase your property value. It's also a smart decision if your family is growing, or if you desire more privacy and comfort, such as an en-suite master bath. Adding a bathroom can significantly improve daily living and is a common renovation that yields a good return on investment, particularly in competitive housing markets where additional amenities are highly valued.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider adding a bathroom if you need more convenience, host guests often, want to boost property value, or need more privacy, like an en-suite master bath.
